claims.label: Summary
claims.explanation: HB 1003 would require a toll project entity’s discount program to provide free or discounted toll use to electronic toll collection customers whose account relates to a vehicle registered to a paramedic, peace officer, or firefighter. It retains the existing eligibility category for vehicles registered under specified Transportation Code provisions.
The bill changes eligibility for free or discounted use of toll projects.
claims.label: Transportation

claims.explanation: These customers become eligible for the required free or discounted toll use when their account relates to a vehicle registered to one of the listed individuals.
claims.label: Electronic toll collection customers with vehicles registered to paramedics, peace officers, or firefighters

claims.explanation: Their programs must include the newly specified customer eligibility.
claims.label: Toll project entities administering discount programs

claims.explanation: Requires toll project discount programs to include customers whose account relates to a vehicle registered to a paramedic, peace officer, or firefighter, while retaining the specified existing vehicle-registration category.
claims.label: Adds eligible toll-discount customers
